name: Career Management Strategies
description: This course enables students to critically evaluate their personal biases and assumptions about work, success, and failure, and to question the mental models that shape their career choices. It guides them to critically analyze the changing nature of work and develop an informed worldview about emerging career patterns. Building on this deeper self-awareness and contextual understanding, students design a sustainable and adaptive career strategy aligned with both personal values and evolving professional realities.
